Privacy Policy

Last Updated: August 19, 2026

1. Data Collection

We collect lead information (names, phone numbers, inquiry details) specifically to route them to our business partners. We do not sell this data to third-party marketing firms.

2. Call Recording

Calls generated by our assets are recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. These recordings are accessible to both DigiiState and the active territory partner.

3. Security

Administrative access to DigiiState OS is restricted to qualified operators using multi-factor authentication and secure protocol keys.
